description: Land Acquisition - Pelwehera, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Inamaluwa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for a railway project, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, occupants, and extents. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters, not government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any other specialized category.
